# Vendored: noir-lang/noir_bigcurve

- Source: https://github.com/noir-lang/noir_bigcurve
- Tag: `v0.14.0`, commit `e7e0fd1eba50675fc9c375326c6e3516cd848fa1`.
- License: **the upstream repository has no LICENSE file.** The project owner accepted using it pinned; tracked in `docs/AUDIT.md`.
- Why vendored: `derive_curve_impl` expands to references to the crate's private modules (`curve_jac`, `utils::hash_to_curve`) and unqualified `ScalarField`/`BigCurve`, so a curve cannot be defined from another crate. Upstream `main` is unchanged. Defining our curves inside the crate is the smallest change that works.
- Changes, all additive:
  - `src/curves/eid_p521.nr`, `eid_bp256.nr`, `eid_bp384.nr`, `eid_bp512.nr`: generated by `rust/eid-vectors` (`eid-vectors curves`); do not edit by hand.
  - `src/curves/mod.nr`: four `pub mod eid_*` lines.
  - Removed `.git`, `.github`, `scripts`, release metadata.

No upstream source line is modified. To update: replace the tree with a newer tag, keep the four `eid_*` files and the `mod.nr` lines, and rerun `eid-vectors curves --check`.
